messages:
maria: Heads-up — opened PR to update the AuroraX-7B model card: adds supported runtimes, updated seq limits, fresh benchmark numbers, and a new SDK streaming snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 Please review for accuracy. @sam @jin @ryan

sam: thanks — will skim the bench numbers today and flag anything off with the test harness.

jin: quick q — you changed the default seq limit? I had 8k in my head for AuroraX.

maria: yep — we bumped the recommended sequence ceiling to 12k for hosted and dedicated with the new kv-prefetch patch, but added a compatibility note: quantized CPU fallbacks and some older runtime builds should use a 8k soft-limit and will trigger an automatic routing fallback.

ryan: can you paste the exact sentence you want in the model card for the fallback note? ops/customer teams need copy they can paste into migration emails.

maria: suggested note: "For sequences >8k, Redwood will prefer the GPU-optimized AuroraX-7B variant; when only quantized CPU variants are available, requests above 8k will be routed to a compatible variant or receive a graceful partial-response with a clear error code. Contact support for dedicated capacity guarantees." Feel free to tweak.

maria: new SDK snippet (python streaming) — please sanity-check:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
with client.stream(model='aurorax-7b', session_config={'compat_mode': 'kv_fallback', 'max_sequence': 12000}) as s:
    for chunk in s.generate(prompt="Summarize...", stream=True):
        print(chunk.text, end='')
```

lina: bench nit: can we add p50/p95/p99 latency for the 8k/12k runs and move raw throughput tables to a separate anchor (#bench-details)? customers ask for p99 a lot.

maria: good call. I'll split detailed numbers under a "Benchmark details" anchor and keep the overview table at top. Proposed overview: p50 45ms (1k), p95 120ms (4k), p99 320ms (8k on GPU), 600ms (12k on GPU, cold kv).

jin: also add a short migration note for Dedicated: commit flavors with nvlink pools may keep 12k but older reserved profiles will default to 8k unless they opt-in to the kv-prefetch config.

ryan: add a single-line compatibility bullet in the catalog row too — helps sales when comparing models.

maria: done, will update the catalog table row and push a follow-up commit. Also adding a small code comment about the compat_mode values in the SDK snippet.

docs-bot: docs-lint: ok — 2 warnings (check anchors), 0 errors.

deploy-bot: CI: docs build succeeded — staging artifacts available at https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/aurorax-7b (renders).

maria: tagging final reviewers @sam @jin — if no objections by EOD I'll merge and then open a lightweight migration KB for customers. :party_parrot:

sam: LGTM from bench perspective, left one inline about clarifying "cold kv" conditions.

jin: LGTM from compatibility side after the Dedicated note.

maria: thanks all — merging in ~2 hours if nothing else pops up. Action items: (1) maria updates anchor + catalog row, (2) ryan will draft the one-paragraph migration KB, (3) lina will add p99 numbers to bench anchor.

maria: marking this thread done once merged.
